user.title: Notification Journal
user.description: Records every notification Home Assistant sends, with its recipients, the automation or script that sent it and its status. You can change what is kept and for how long in the options.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Notification Journal is already set up.

sources.name: Sources
sources.description: What is recorded. A source turned off records nothing more; what is already in the history stays.

data_description.record_notify: Calls of notify actions: companion app, groups and every other notify action.
data_description.record_persistent_notifications: The bell in the sidebar, with when and by whom they were dismissed. Like in Home Assistant, every user sees them.
data_description.record_speech: tts.speak on media players and assist_satellite.announce on voice satellites, with text. Every user sees them.
data_description.record_telegram: Messages, captioned photos, videos and files, and polls sent with the Telegram bot's own actions. Only administrators see them.
data_description.excluded_channels: Channels whose notifications are not recorded, from any source: a notify action or entity, a media player or a voice satellite.

data_description.retention_days: Older entries are deleted once a day.
data_description.max_entries: When there are more, the oldest are deleted first.
data_description.statistics_years: Hourly counts behind the statistics, without any text; whole calendar years, at least two to compare a year with the one before, and never shorter than the notifications.

data_description.show_in_sidebar: When hidden, the history stays reachable under /notification-journal.
data_description.panel_title: Empty: the name in the language of Home Assistant.
data_description.panel_icon: Empty: the icon of the integration.

options.own: The notifications sent to them and the bell

not_loaded.message: Notification Journal is not set up.

query.name: Query
query.description: Returns the recorded notifications that match the filters as response data, newest first unless asked otherwise. Called by a user who is no administrator, only what the panel shows them.

text.name: Text
text.description: Words in the title, message, recipients or origin; each word as the start of a word.

channel.name: Channel
channel.description: The notify action, notify entity or group the notifications went to.

origin.name: Origin
origin.description: The automation or script that sent them, `integration.` followed by an integration's domain, or `user`, `system` or `unknown`.

status.name: Status
status.description: Only failed notifications (in whole or in part), or only answered ones.

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: The Companion app's tag the notifications were sent with.

since.name: Since
since.description: Only notifications sent at or after this time.

until.name: Until
until.description: Only notifications sent before this time.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: How many notifications to return, at most 200.

newest_first.name: Newest first
newest_first.description: Return the newest notifications first; off for the oldest first.
